title: Blue Whale ka Dil Minute Mein Sirf 2 Baar
idea: While diving, a blue whale's heart can slow to about 2 beats per minute. The Short builds to that with its size, weight and elephant-sized tongue.

title: Venus pe Din, Saal Se Bhi Lamba!
idea: Venus spins so slowly (243 Earth days per rotation) that its day is longer than its 225-day year, and it spins backwards so the Sun rises in the west.

title: Bijli Sooraj Se 5 Guna Garam!
idea: A lightning bolt heats the air to about 27,700°C, roughly 5 times hotter than the Sun's surface. The record bolt was 829 km long, and counting the seconds before the thunder tells you how far away it struck.

title: Kaagaz 42 Baar Fold Karo, Chaand Tak Pahunch Jaoge!
idea: A sheet of paper 0.1 mm thick that doubles with every fold would pass the Burj Khalifa at 23 folds and Everest at 27 folds, and would go past the Moon at 42 folds.

title: Cleopatra Chaand Ke Zyada Kareeb Thi, Pyramid Ke Nahi!
idea: Cleopatra was born about 2,490 years after the Great Pyramid was finished, but only about 2,040 years before the Moon landing, so she lived closer in time to Apollo 11 than to the pyramid's construction.

title: Phone Charger Apollo 11 Se Tez!
idea: A modern USB-C charger chip runs about 48x faster than the 1.024 MHz Apollo 11 Guidance Computer that landed humans on the Moon with roughly 4 KB of RAM.

title: Madhumakkhi Ki Poori Zindagi = Sirf 1/12 Chammach Shahad!
idea: A worker honeybee makes only about 1/12 of a teaspoon of honey in her whole life, so one spoonful takes about 12 bees' lifetimes, and a pound of honey takes about 2 million flowers and 55,000 miles of flying.

title: Body Har Second 20 Lakh Khoon Cells Banata Hai!
idea: Your bone marrow makes about 2 million new red blood cells every second, roughly India's whole population in about 12 minutes, because each one lives only about 120 days.

title: Ek Chammach Taara = 100 Crore Ton!
idea: A teaspoon of neutron star matter would weigh about a billion tons on Earth. The star holds more mass than the Sun in a ball about 20 km wide, and the fastest one spins 716 times per second.

title: Shark Pedon Se Bhi Purani Hai!
idea: Sharks have been around for about 450 million years. That makes them older than trees, dinosaurs and even the Himalayas, and they lived through all five mass extinctions.

title: Octopus: 3 Dil, 9 Dimaag, Neela Khoon!
idea: An octopus has three hearts and copper-based blue blood, one heart pauses briefly when it swims, and about two-thirds of its 500 million neurons are in its arms.

title: Saturn Paani Mein Tair Sakta Hai!
idea: Saturn's average density (0.687 g/cm³) is lower than water's, so in theory it would float, even though 764 Earths could fit inside it.

title: Eiffel Tower Ko Har 7 Saal Mein 60 Ton Paint!
idea: Every ~7 years the Eiffel Tower gets repainted by hand. Each job uses about 60 tonnes of paint, roughly 50 painters and covers 250,000 m². It has been repainted 20 times in 136 years.

title: Astronaut Roz 16 Baar Sooraj Ugte Dekhte Hain!
idea: The ISS circles Earth about every 90 minutes at ~28,000 km/h, so astronauts see about 16 sunrises and sunsets every day.

title: 100 Crore Second = Poore 31 Saal!
idea: How hugely different 1 million, 10 million, 1 billion and 1 trillion seconds are when counted in days and years, shown in lakh and crore.

title: Aap Abhi 1 Lakh Km/h Se Bhaag Rahe Ho!
idea: Even while sitting still, you are moving at about 107,000 km/h because Earth is orbiting the Sun at about 29.78 km/s.

title: Cube Poop Karne Wala Anokha Jaanwar! 🐻 #shorts
idea: Explaining how wombats naturally produce cube-shaped poop and other incredible biological facts about them in Hinglish.

title: Woodpecker Ka Super Brain
idea: How woodpeckers withstand 1000 g impacts without brain damage

title: Statue of Liberty Asal Mein Ek Dhoka Hai? 🗽 #shorts
idea: The massive Statue of Liberty's copper skin is shockingly thin at just 2.4 mm, yet required 91,000 kg of copper.

title: Iss Jaanwar Ke Paas Hai Sabse Ghani Fur! 🦦 #shorts
idea: Explaining how sea otters have the densest fur on Earth along with other insane physical facts

title: Chameleon Ki Jeebh Ka Dhasu Sach! 🦎 #shorts
idea: Mind-blowing physical facts about chameleon's tongue speed, 360-degree vision, and glowing bones.

title: Giraffe Ki Gardan Ka Sabse Bada Dhoka! 🦒 #shorts
idea: Explaining how a giraffe's massive 2.4-meter neck contains only 7 vertebrae—the exact same number as a human.

title: Burj Khalifa Ki Top Se Kya Dikhta Hai? 🏙️ #shorts
idea: Burj Khalifa's tip is so high that its tip can be seen from 95 kilometers away.

title: Platypus Stomach Fact
idea: Platypuses do not have a stomach, so food goes straight from the esophagus into the intestines.
